description: This file defines the ResourceStatus interface and associated classes/enums that represent the status of a resource such as a client connection, source, or target within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for retrieving resource properties, status, and type, as well as JSON serialization details.

classes.name: ResourceStatus
classes.description: Main interface representing the status of a resource with methods to access its properties, status, type, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: ResourceStatus.ResourceType
classes.description: Enum defining the type of resource: SOURCE, TARGET, CLIENT, or UNKNOWN.

classes.name: ResourceStatus.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class defining the JSON field definitions used in serialization/deserialization of ResourceStatus objects.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the type of the resource.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client identifier associated with the resource.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the address of the resource, if available.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current connectivity status of the resource.

methods.name: getStatusDetails
methods.description: Returns additional status details, if available.

methods.name: getInStateSince
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Instant since the resource has been in this state.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ResourceStatus to a JSON object, including only non hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the ResourceStatus to a JSON object with a specific schema version and field selector.
